observations: Photo 0 shows a stainless steel standing gas cooker with four burners and an oven door open.
Photo 1 shows the same cooker from a slightly different angle, with the top burners visible and the oven door open.
Photo 2 shows the same cooker from a front-facing angle, with the oven door open.
All photos show the cooker in a workshop or storage area with other appliances in the background.
The top burners appear to be electric or gas, with black tops and metal grates.
The oven has a single rack inside, and the door has a black handle and a stainless steel frame.
The surface of the cooker shows some smudges and minor wear, especially on the top surface.
No brand or model name is visible on the front or sides of the cooker in any photo.
The seller claims it is 'refurbished' and 'in perfect working condition'.
